_comment: DeepCoreOverhaul audio manifest. Consumed by tools/audio/generate.py.
OUTPUT FORMAT IS FIXED BY THE ENGINE, NOT BY TASTE: every secondary sound buffer is
created with DSBCAPS_CTRL3D unconditionally (3DSound.cpp:1123), and DirectSound3D
buffers are mono-only, so a stereo file fails to create a buffer and the engine says
only 'Cannot create sound buffer.'. Everything here is generated as PCM 22050 Hz
16-bit MONO, which also matches the primary buffer (3DSound.cpp:154-156) and so
avoids a resample at mix time.
NAMING RULE: the L in LRR is never expanded, and that includes spoken lines. Any
entry whose text or prompt contains it is rejected by the validator.
VOICES: original voices in a fitting register. This project never clones or imitates
the original game's voice actors or any real person. Voice names below are resolved
against the account's own catalogue at generation time.
All generated audio is original work and is committable. Nothing extracted from the

commander._role: Mission control. Calm, procedural, unhurried even when things are bad. The voice that has done this a hundred times.

geologist._role: Survey and science briefings. Precise, curious, slightly clipped.

alert._role: Threat warnings only. Tighter, faster, more pressure. Never used for anything routine, so the player learns its meaning instantly.

entries._group: THREAT LAYER -- driven by the wave director.
entries._note: The director already owns escalation state: telegraph phase, alive budget, wave number. Nothing else in the project can drive audio from real threat state, which is why this is first.
entries.name: dc_threat_telegraph
entries.text: Movement in the rock. Something is coming through.

entries.name: dc_threat_telegraph_heavy
entries.text: Multiple contacts. They are coming through the walls.

entries.name: dc_threat_escalate
entries.text: Pressure is building down there. Do not let them settle.

entries.name: dc_threat_cleared
entries.text: Cavern is quiet again. Use it.

entries.name: dc_sting_warning
entries.prompt: Low ominous sub-bass swell with a distant rock groan, tense, building, cavernous, no music, ends unresolved

entries.name: dc_sting_arrival
entries.prompt: Heavy rock bursting outward, stone shattering and tumbling, deep impact thud, close and violent

entries.name: dc_sting_relief
entries.prompt: Tension releasing, low tone fading into settling gravel and quiet cave ambience, calm resolution

entries._group: CREATURE VOCALISATIONS -- eleven species that currently blur together.
entries._note: Cosmetic variants already make individuals differ in size and colour; this makes them differ in what you hear coming.
entries.name: dc_creature_rock_alert
entries.prompt: Massive stone creature waking, grinding boulder-on-boulder growl, deep and slow, threatening

entries.name: dc_creature_ice_alert
entries.prompt: Cracking ice and splintering frost, sharp brittle shriek layered over a low freezing groan

entries.name: dc_creature_lava_alert
entries.prompt: Molten rock hissing and spitting, roaring furnace breath, bubbling magma, dangerous heat

entries.name: dc_creature_small_skitter
entries.prompt: Small many-legged creature skittering fast over loose stone, chittering, quick and unsettling

entries._group: CAMPAIGN BRIEFINGS -- what makes authored content feel official.
entries._note: Text is placeholder-quality until the campaign missions are written; the pipeline is what matters here. Regenerating after a rewrite is one command.
entries.name: dc_brief_01_descent
entries.text: Welcome to the deep core. The seam below you is rich, and it is not empty. Get a base standing, get your crew underground, and be ready to lose the first cavern you dig into.

entries.name: dc_brief_02_pressure
entries.text: The survey was wrong. There is far more moving down here than we mapped. Hold what you have taken and do not spread thin.

entries.name: dc_brief_03_heat
entries.text: Temperature is climbing the deeper you cut. Whatever lives in the hot rock does not mind it. Your machines will.

entries.name: dc_objective_complete
entries.text: Objective secured. Good work down there.

entries.name: dc_objective_failed
entries.text: We have lost the cavern. Pull everyone back to the surface.

entries.name: dc_ambience_rock
entries.prompt: Deep underground cavern ambience, distant dripping water, faint settling stone, vast empty space, no music

entries.name: dc_ambience_ice
entries.prompt: Frozen cavern ambience, distant ice groaning and cracking, cold hollow wind, sparse, no music

entries.name: dc_ambience_lava
entries.prompt: Volcanic cavern ambience, low magma rumble, distant hissing steam vents, oppressive heat, no music
